description: This file defines functions for interacting with a Todo API, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting todos. It exports these functions for use in other parts of the frontend application.

methods.name: listTodos({ token, completed, search, priority } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of todos from the API with optional filters such as completion status, search term, and priority.

methods.name: createTodo({ token, todo })
methods.description: Creates a new todo item by sending a POST request with todo data.

methods.name: updateTodo({ token, id, updates })
methods.description: Updates an existing todo identified by 'id' with provided updates via a PUT request.

methods.name: destroyTodo({ token, id })
methods.description: Deletes a specific todo identified by 'id' using a DELETE request.

ctags.name: listTodos
ctags.pattern: /^export function listTodos({ token, completed, search, priority } = {}) {$/
